summary: Teach the evidence skip policy per-signer-level rules and event limits, and admit the host signer level for two checks on pull requests, without enforcing anything

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes; this changes the CI evidence verifier, gate and policy files only.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes. Every check stays enforce false, so nothing skips because of this change.

compatibility.detail: No command, frame, scope or stored-format change in the product; the skip policy gains an optional by_level key that older verifiers reject, which fails closed.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator action is required by this change.

recovery.detail: No persistent product state changes or new swap-back restrictions.
